announcements.summary: Intimation of Earnings Call under the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015  Listing Regulations
Sasken Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Earnings Call under the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015  Listing Regulations '.
Sasken Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 28, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share.

We are enclosing herewith Standalone and Consolidated audited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, as taken on record at the Board Meeting held today.The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs.12 (120%) per equity share of Rs.10 each for theFinancial Year 2026-27.As intimated vide our letter dated October 21, 2026, Board has fixed Tuesday, November 3, 2026, as the Record Date to ascertain the list of shareholders eligible for the aforesaid Interim Dividend and the same will be paid on or before Thursday, November 26, 2026.
Sasken Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Sasken Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 03-Nov-2026.
